body: Proposed fail-closed fix: throw a CheckpointGapError when startLedger is ahead of the checkpoint. Payout to a Base USDC address.
Submitted PR #74: checkpointed run resumes from lastProcessedLedger + 1 and ignores startLedger; new predicate logs a warning with the rebuild reason.
Proposed an audit approach: log the skipped interval, require operator confirmation or record gap metadata, integration test. Payout options listed.
Asked about remaining funded tasks, eligibility, payment and acceptance terms.

Submitted PR #120: computeLedgerRange resumes from lastProcessedLedger + 1 when a checkpoint exists, startLedgerAheadOfCheckpoint helper, warning pointing to the rebuild procedure, unit and orchestration tests. Base USDC payout requested.
